UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user's profile, off-device cloud storage meter, and end-to-end encryption vault metadata.

e2eeEnabled.description: Whether E2EE private folder passphrase is set.

e2eeSalt.description: Base64 PBKDF2 salt for E2EE key derivation.

e2eeVerifier.description: AES-GCM encrypted verifier token to validate passphrase across devices.

storageUsedBytes.description: Total off-device cloud bytes stored across documents.

VaultFolder.title: VaultFolder
VaultFolder.description: Custom document folder with tags and optional end-to-end encryption privacy flag.

colorHex.description: Accent hex color for the folder badge.

privateVault.description: Whether files in this folder use client-side AES-256-GCM E2EE.

VaultDocument.title: VaultDocument
VaultDocument.description: Lightweight searchable metadata, OCR extracted text, AI categorization, editable upload date, and E2EE ciphertext envelope for a stored document or photo.

title.description: Document display title (or masked placeholder when E2EE encrypted).

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

uploadDateMillis.description: Editable upload/filing date in epoch milliseconds.

tags.description: User and AI assigned searchable tags.

extractedText.description: OCR / parsed text content (empty when encrypted).

hasCloudBlob.description: Whether an off-device file payload is stored in doc_blobs.

encrypted.description: Whether sensitive content is E2EE encrypted.

encryptedPayload.description: Base64 AES-256-GCM ciphertext JSON for E2EE metadata and OCR text.

DocumentBlob.title: DocumentBlob
DocumentBlob.description: Off-device cloud storage payload for a document photo or file, loaded lazily on detail view.

dataBase64.description: Base64 raw or AES-GCM encrypted file bytes.

byteLength.description: Size of stored cloud payload in bytes.

SavedWebsite.title: SavedWebsite
SavedWebsite.description: User-saved website search template for direct lookup from highlighted OCR document text.

urlTemplate.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL or search template with optional {query} placeholder.

category.description: Website category such as Tracking, Finance, or Custom.

usageCount.description: Number of times launched from highlighted text.

SearchHistoryEntry.title: SearchHistoryEntry
SearchHistoryEntry.description: Synced history of keyword searches, AI document Q&A prompts, and highlighted-text web lookups.

query.description: Search query, AI question, or highlighted lookup phrase.

aiAnswerPreview.description: Optional AI answer snippet or website name.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user profile, E2EE vault salt/verifier, and cloud storage usage.

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}.description: User's custom and E2EE private document folders.

/users/{userId}/documents/{docId}.description: User's searchable document index with OCR text, tags, AI categories, and editable upload date.

/users/{userId}/doc_blobs/{docId}.description: User's off-device cloud storage payloads fetched lazily on open.

/users/{userId}/saved_websites/{siteId}.description: User's saved lookup websites for direct highlighted-text search.

/users/{userId}/search_history/{historyI.description: User's synced search bar and AI Q&A history.
